verdict.rationale: Anytype runs a dedicated developer portal with a versioned API reference that explicitly says it is for building 'powerful extensions' (anytype-docs-69, anytype-supp-api-versions). It also publishes an OpenAPI spec (anytype-supp-openapi-v2), a localhost API bundled with the desktop app (anytype-docs-1), a CLI (anytype-docs-2) and a featured examples section such as the MCP server (anytype-docs-70); the GitHub repo cites a gRPC API for extensibility (anytype-gh-2). However, these are external integration APIs rather than an in-app plugin system. Missing for 10: an in-app plugin/extension SDK that lets you extend the UI or behavior, documented plugin samples beyond the MCP example, and independent hands-on corroboration of building extensions.
